description: This Java class is a Spring Boot component that initializes sample data such as users and products in the database when the application starts. It implements CommandLineRunner to execute data setup logic, creating an admin user, a normal user, and several sample products for an online shopping platform.

classes.name: DataInitializer
classes.description: A Spring component that initializes sample user and product data during application startup.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Entry point executed on application startup; checks for existing data and populates database with sample users and products if empty.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create and save a product with specific attributes into the repository.
